_comment: PWNAGE-31000/62000 pre-lockscreen cinema. The controller plays this asset as a fullscreen, audio-free Wayland client over the real Nuxel lockscreen. Presentation readiness (launcher document + display bridge + panel on) releases the overlay at video EOF, with a short final_frame_grace_ms fallback. Touch/input readiness is reported separately and never holds the final frame. This JSON file is the single authoritative default source; nuxel-session.sh must not pass duplicate default timings. audio=never is deliberate.

_asset.video: H.264 High, 1080x1920, 24 fps, 144 frames, yuv420p, bt709/tv
_asset.audio: AAC-LC, 48000 Hz, stereo; deliberately not played
_asset.decode: software decode via mpv/FFmpeg-free; verified with ffmpeg -f null on the build host

_readiness.display: FRAMES_OK/owner=nuxel-wl-fb in /run/nuxel-wl-fb.state, with a fresh DISPLAY_ON + owner=nuxel-wl-fb in /var/lib/nuxel/display (stale receipts ignored)
_readiness.touch: an ARMED_OK status receipt (later TOUCH_POINT event lines are ignored), or an honest NO_TOUCH_DEVICE/SCAN_FAIL warning in /run/nuxel-touch-arm.state
